name: NEWCHAE SHOT
overview: NEWCHAE SHOT is a home-care beauty device integrating professional-grade medical technologies into a compact form factor with multi-channel energy delivery.
description: Combining RF tightening, EMS contouring, and ELP skin boosting technologies, NEWCHAE SHOT delivers clinical-grade results for home use.

keyTechnologies.name: RF Mode (Tightening)
keyTechnologies.description: Multi-Channel RF Stack technology delivers heat deep into the dermis, promoting collagen regeneration.

keyTechnologies.name: EMS Mode (V-Line)
keyTechnologies.description: Electrical Muscle Stimulation for facial contouring and toning.

keyTechnologies.name: ELP Mode (Skin Boost)
keyTechnologies.description: Electroporation technology enhances absorption of skincare products.

indications: Skin Tightening - RF energy stimulates collagen for firmer skin
Face Contouring - EMS tones facial muscles for V-line effect
Product Absorption - ELP enhances skincare penetration
Anti-Aging - Reduces fine lines and improves skin texture

differentiators.description: Concentrates energy output for precise delivery at optimal intervals
Vibrates 10,000 times/min to assist energy penetration and comfort
Professional technology miniaturized for convenient daily home use
